10 HOMES. AN OWNERSHIP PATH.

Ten income-restricted townhomes are under construction at 7331 Menchaca Road in South Austin, according to a November 6 City announcement.

All ten homes are reserved for households earning at or below 80% of Area Median Income. The mix includes eight two-bedroom homes and two three-bedroom homes, with long-term affordability requirements and resale restrictions.

The City lists maximum prices of $253,000 for two-bedroom homes and $289,500 for three-bedroom homes under its affordable housing guidelines.

Why this matters: it adds a small, specific source of below-market ownership housing in South Austin. It does not establish a citywide price trend or mean comparable unrestricted homes will sell at those prices.

Austin Housing Finance Corporation provided $1.9 million through its Ownership Housing Development Assistance program. The City says construction began in August, with three homes at the framing stage when announced.

Homes will be listed when available for occupancy. Income verification is required, and the City says further buyer-process details will be released later.

Source: City of Austin Housing, November 6, 2026.
